Sam: Quick lunchtime game — one-line origin story for whatever's on your desk right now. I'll kick it off: 'My stapler was forged in a thunderstorm and only staples when you're honest.' Go!
Priya: 'I was a coffee bean until a wizard spilled me into a mug and now I fuel spreadsheets.' ☕️
Liam: 'Born in a startup garage, I learned to juggle keyboards and deadlines.' :sunglasses:
Jules: 'I used to be a nap until HR rebranded it as a "wellness initiative".' :joy:
Kai: 'The mute button: formerly a tiny island nation; now dictator of meetings.' :raised_hands:
Sam: OK new rule — best one gets a sticker from the weird drawer. Vote with reactions: :one: for Priya, :two: for Liam, :three: for Jules, :four: for Kai
deploy-bot: Reminder: Sticker drawer restocked at 12:30. Inventory: `tiny-rocket`, `vintage-staple`, `soggy-toast`, `micro-meme`.
Priya: also small kudos to @Liam for bringing the bagels earlier — legend status. :bagel: :trophy:
Liam: @Priya hero move. :heart:
Jules: We're settling this important question: is 'soggy-toast' a valid sticker name? Vote with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:
